# anatomy: the practice's mechanics

This page holds where anatomy's work lands in the workspace, which `SKILL.md` names by its nouns. Read it with `SKILL.md` when the work lands in the workspace.
passages.reason: Opens anatomy's references page and says when to read it.
passages.gist: Opens anatomy's references page and says when to read it

passages.text:
## Where its work lands

A figure made to explain a mechanism of the code is a durable visual: its page, `.greenline/visuals/<id>/<slug>.html`, stands under the change with its manifest `<slug>.visual.json` beside it in the form `.greenline/WORK.md` gives ("Durable visuals"), its `skill` `anatomy` and its `form` `figure`; its brief, written before it is built at `.greenline/tmp/<id>/pictures/<slug>.brief.md`, one line a field, is read into the manifest's `brief` by `greenline picture keep`, and `greenline status` names a kept figure without one (GL0606). The keep takes the page alone, and the hooks refuse every other file in the change's folder of the home: its build script and its model module are the record's, copied into the change's ledger folder, `.greenline/ledger/<id>/sources/<slug>/`. A figure for the project's docs or site is a product file: the change writes its script, its model and its page where the owner places them. Either way the record's build section names them. Captures, the ringed PNG of the line check and the audit's output go under the change's working files, `.greenline/tmp/<id>/anatomy/`, never the host's temporary directory and never a `shots/` folder in the repository: `capture.mjs`, `print.mjs` and `lines.mjs` take the path with their `--out` flag, `drive.mjs` takes it in each action's file name, and the audit's report is its standard output, redirected there. What a verdict relies on is promoted to `.greenline/ledger/<id>/verify/<claim-slug>/` before the verify section cites it, or at the independent depth the verifier's report, as verify's references page says.
passages.reason: Where the figure's files land since J-110 S4: an explaining figure in the visual home with its manifest, a docs or site figure where the owner places it; its captures and its audit output in the change's working files. J-149 S1: at the independent depth the verify section cites the verifier's report alone, which cites the evidence. J-204 S1 (the register's row of 2026-11-08, "One offer per change at the caps"): the figure's brief file, read into its manifest. J-227 S1 (the register's row of 2026-11-05, "The keeper over the oracle"; j201t-visuals finding 5, j201t-linear-visuals finding 7): the figure's build script and model module are record, copied into the change's ledger folder, since the keep takes one picture file and the hooks refuse any other file in the home.
passages.gist: Lands figures beside their manifest, captures in working files

keepers.promise: A figure is never made or remade unasked, and nothing is offered: on the owner's ask a fresh agent builds it, its size named with the time for a Hero or an Epic.
keepers.reason: No fact marks a turn as owing a figure. The picture-offer hold fires only after an inline picture or at a rubric turn. J-147's plan records that anatomy was never loaded across the series' 101 runs, but no free or cheap reading can tell that a figure was owed.

keepers.promise: On the yes a fresh agent builds it.

It names the size first, starts no Epic without the owner's choice (giving the estimate, a Hero proposal and what the full version adds), and tells the owner where it stands when a step runs past twice its share.
keepers.reason: These are waits and reports in the reply that no hook reads. No cited run built a figure.

keepers.promise: When a change touches the code a figure explains, the close names the figure, and its remake waits for the owner's ask.
A figure made to explain lands under the change in the visual home beside its manifest (skill anatomy, form figure); a figure for the docs or site is a product file placed where the owner says.
The figure's page alone is kept in the visual home; its build script and model module are copied into the change's ledger folder, .greenline/ledger/<id>/sources/<slug>/, never beside the figure.
Captures, the line check's ringed PNG and the audit output go under .greenline/tmp/<id>/anatomy/, never in the host's temporary directory or a shots/ folder in the repository.
keepers.reason: Once the owner says yes, no hold reads where these writes land. The Linear replay's F14 (a fresh agent writing under /tmp) was a verifier, not this skill, and was graded a note.

keepers.promise: What a verdict relies on is promoted to .greenline/ledger/<id>/verify/<claim-slug>/ before the verify section cites it.
The build and verify sections name the script, the model, the page, the captures and the audit output, and the verify section says so when only the quick audit ran.
keepers.reason: No lint reads these section contents today, and J-149's planned lint does not name them. No cited run observed a failure.

keepers.promise: When the owner wants the figure on paper and has not picked a format, it offers all three.
keepers.reason: This is an offer in the reply with no reading, and no cited run reached it.
